problems.title: Trace 1. Sum of n values
problems.description:
First input is n. Second line has n integers.
Sum values by index and fill i, value, sum.

Example table:
| i | value | sum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ... | 1 | 0 |
problems.code:
n = int(input())
vals = list(map(int, input().split()))
sumv = 0
for i in range(n):
    sumv += vals[i]
print(sumv)

problems.title: Reverse 1. Find the second input
problems.description:
You are told the first input and the final product.
Find the missing second input. (number only)
problems.code:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
print(a * b)

problems.title: Trace 2. Name and two scores
problems.description:
Read a name and two scores from one line.
Convert scores to int and print name with their sum. Fill the table.

Example table:
| name | s1 | s2 | output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Amy | 70 | 80 | 0 |
problems.code:
name, s1, s2 = input().split()
s1 = int(s1)
s2 = int(s2)
print(name, s1 + s2)
